title: China and North Korea aid to Russia poses security risk in Indo-Pacific region, says top US commander
description: Beijing and Pyongyang are aiding Russia in its war against Ukraine, and Moscow in turn is assisting their militaries

title: U.S. ambassador to step down as peace talks uncertain
description: The U.S. ambassador to Ukraine is stepping down from her post after nearly three years in Kyiv amid uncertainty over the Trump administration’s attempts to broker a peace deal to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

title: Ukraine war latest: Zelenskyy accuses Russia of 'systemic' work to recruit fighters in China
description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has accused Russia of actively recruiting fighters in China, which Moscow and Beijing deny. Ukraine's leader earlier claimed 155 Chinese citizens were fighting for the Russian military. Meanwhile, a US-Russia prisoner swap has gone ahead.

title: Drone video appears to show Russian troops execute 4 Ukrainian POWs, AP analysis finds
description: Two videos, two different stories about Russia's war in Ukraine. In one, four Ukrainian POWs appear to live. In the other, they're seen being executed.

title: ‘Do you want to show strength here?’: Russia’s ads recruiting Chinese mercenaries
description: More than 150 Chinese nationals are fighting for Russia in Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said, recruited via videos on social media

title: Ukraine war latest: China responds to claims more than 150 citizens fighting for Russia - as Zelenskyy says he 'doesn't understand' US inaction
description: China has responded after Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed 155 Chinese citizens were fighting for the Russian military. Zelenskyy has also said he doesn't understand US inaction against Russia. Follow the latest below - as a "coalition of the willing" meeting is held in Brussels.

title: China calls Zelenkyy's remarks on Chinese fighters in Ukraine 'irresponsible'
description: BEIJING (AP) — China on Thursday described as “irresponsible" accusations by Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy that Russia is actively recruiting Chinese citizens to fight alongside its forces in the Ukraine

title: Kremlin Dismisses Zelenskiy's Claims on China's Role in Ukraine
description: The Kremlin refutes Ukrainian President Zelenskiy's assertion of China's involvement in Ukraine's conflict, emphasizing Beijing's balanced stance. Zelenskiy alleged Chinese fighters' presence on Russia's side, prompting a stern response from China. The Kremlin reaffirmed China as a strategic ally, denying claims of involvement.

title: Defense chiefs from around 30 countries expected at NATO for talks on a future Ukraine force
description: Britain and France are convening a meeting of defense ministers from around 30 countries to press ahead with plans to deploy troops to Ukraine to police any future peace agreement with Russia.

title: Russia Recruited Dozens of Chinese Troops Via TikTok, Zelensky Says
description: At least 163 Chinese nationals are serving in Russia's Armed Forces, the Kyiv Independent reported.
